The fix that matters most: the speech is typeset, not dumped.

Today the app prints the model's raw markdown — ## TITLE, ## HOOK — in a monospace box. Here each section is a real section, [stage directions] read as cues rather than clutter, and prose is set in a serif you can actually read aloud from.

Two alternates to the proposed direction, same screen so the comparison is fair.

LECTERN — print/editorial. Caslon, rules, mono labels. Closest to what you have now, but committed. Quietest; least distinctive.

PODIUM — the app as stage equipment. Dark by default, amber focus, the teleprompter aesthetic everywhere. Strong for performance; heavier for long form-filling.
